form.notes: NEW for tax year 2025 under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. Attachment Sequence No. 1A, Cat. No. 95872Q. Six parts: I MAGI (1-3), II No Tax on Tips (4-13), III No Tax on Overtime (14-21), IV No Tax on Car Loan Interest (22-30), V Enhanced Deduction for Seniors (31-37), VI Total Additional Deductions (38). These four deductions are available whether the taxpayer claims the standard deduction or itemizes; they are taken at 1040 line 13b, below AGI. Line 22 is a two-row table (22a, 22b) with columns (i) VIN, (ii) interest deducted on Schedule C/E/F, and (iii) the amount carried to Schedule 1-A; only column (iii) is summed by line 23. The table's caption reads: 'Column (iii) is the total QPVLI paid in 2025 less the amounts reported in column (ii).' Each of Parts II, III and V prints a Caution requiring a valid social security number and, for married taxpayers, a joint return. ROUNDING TRAP: lines 11, 19 and 28 each divide an excess by $1,000 and round to a whole number, but NOT in the same direction. Lines 11 (tips) and 19 (overtime) DECREASE to the next lower whole number - floor - which favours the taxpayer. Line 28 (car loan interest) INCREASES to the next higher whole number - ceiling - which does not. These three lines carry no computes[] entry because floor and ceiling are outside the expression grammar; an implementer must read the captions. The phaseout rates also differ: $100 per $1,000 for tips and overtime, $200 per $1,000 for car loan interest, and Part V is not a per-$1,000 step at all but a flat 6% of the excess over the threshold. PER-PERSON TRAP in Part V: line 35 computes ONE reduced per-person allowance, and BOTH 36a (you) and 36b (spouse) enter that same line 35 amount. So on a joint return where both spouses qualify, the 6% reduction is taken TWICE - it is not 'reduce $12,000 by 6% of the excess'. Schedule 1-A has no separate instructions document: irs.gov/instructions/i1040s1a is a 404, and its instructions sit inside i1040gi. Part V (lines 31-37) and line 38 carry no per-line instructions there at all.
